name: Project orchestrator
description: A project's orchestrator: a chat that learns the project, settles its open questions with you, hears what its other chats do, and coordinates the work with you.
author: Codex Mods
about: Choose "New project orchestrator" in a project's menu. It starts a chat that reads the project's goals, plans and current chats, then asks you about what's still open, one question at a time.

Each message it gets says what changed in the project's other chats since its last one. With "Tells the orchestrator when a chat finishes" on (What it may do without asking), it also hears when a chat finishes. It can read a chat, message one or start one; you're asked before it sends anything.

automatic.why: Tells the orchestrator when one of its project's chats finishes, so it can act on it.
